column_description: VARCHAR(20). Unique distribution hub identifier. PK.
REAL. Hub's capacity in tons. Example: 5101.
REAL. Hub's storage capacity in cubic meters. Example: 93293.
REAL. Available storage capacity in cubic meters. Example: 7279.
REAL. Cold storage capacity in cubic meters. Example: 249.
REAL. Cold storage temperature in Celsius. **NULL means cold storage temperature not recorded.**. Example: 6.6.
TEXT. Warehouse operational state. Possible values: Excellent, Fair, Good, Poor.
